entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello? Uh, yes. I think I need to make a return. I bought these cycling shoes and they just... they're not right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Peterson, order number VF886-01. I'm just so overwhelmed by all this. The website was a bit confusing.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the shoes were delivered about three weeks ago. Just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I don't know what you'd call it. I tried putting the cleats on and went for one ride, but my feet hurt so badly. I have awful blisters now. They just don't work for me. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for waiting. I've reviewed your order and our policy. It looks like you received the item 21 days ago, and our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days. So, you are well within the window. We can absolutely process that refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. I am emailing a pre-paid return label to you right now. Just package the cycling shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Mark. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
